# Zig toolchain governance record

This directory contains only the upstream license and MacScope patch ledger for
the checksum-pinned Zig 0.15.2 toolchain used by the explicit Ghostty VT
materializer. The Zig executable and `lib/` tree are external materialized
inputs and are not committed.

Authoritative identity and acquisition data live in
`THIRD_PARTY_COMPONENTS.yml`, `Scripts/ghostty-vt-source.contract`, and
`Scripts/dependencies/materialize_zig_toolchain.sh`.
